# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

Contributors must keep project spaces welcoming, respectful, and free from
harassment. Maintainers may remove content or participation that violates these
standards.

Reports may be sent privately to `yowainwright@gmail.com`. Reports will be kept
confidential to the extent possible and reviewed promptly and fairly.

This policy applies in repository discussions, issues, pull requests, reviews,
and other spaces where someone represents the project.
